sources.title: Flows of extremal attractor black holes

evidence.text: How do nonsupersymmetric extremal AdS attractor black holes change after adding a dilaton bare potential representing a relevant deformation, and which resulting branches are thermodynamically preferred?

sources.title: Black Hole Chemistry Knows Extra Dimensions

evidence.text: Can instanton-controlled compact dimensions provide a physical interpretation of varying thermodynamic pressure, and how does their size affect AdS black-hole phase transitions and thermodynamically preferred horizon sizes?

sources.title: Black hole transitions, AdS spacetime, and the distance conjecture

evidence.text: Can neutral black hole instabilities provide a bottom-up formulation of the AdS Distance Conjecture through physical energy scales, and suggest an extension beyond asymptotic field-space limits?

sources.title: Anti-de Sitter fragmentation

evidence.text: Which near-horizon limits define AdS2 quantum gravity, which excitations and fragmented geometries survive, and can their ground states account for extremal black-hole entropy? When can charged-brane instantons fragment AdS universes?

sources.title: Flows of extremal attractor black holes

evidence.text: Double-expand z³G in scalar and radial deviations near the horizon, separating homogeneous and inhomogeneous scalar solutions. Numerically interpolate to the AdS boundary and impose mixed boundary conditions through intersections β_s(α) = β_b.c.(α).

sources.title: Black Hole Chemistry Knows Extra Dimensions

evidence.text: Construct extended first laws, Smarr relations, equations of state and Gibbs free energies for Schwarzschild-AdS, equal-charge dyonic and Kerr-AdS solutions. Determine phase boundaries and map pressure to stabilized internal size; the dyonic coexistence boundary is evaluated numerically.

sources.title: Black hole transitions, AdS spacetime, and the distance conjecture

evidence.text: Review product-mode separation of the Lichnerowicz operator and the connection between Euclidean negative modes and Lorentzian Gregory-Laflamme thresholds. A complementary argument compares a one-loop thermal tachyonic contribution with the BF stability bound.

sources.title: Anti-de Sitter fragmentation

evidence.text: Spherically symmetric Euclidean probe-brane trajectories follow from conserved Euclidean energy and are continued to Lorentzian evolution. The Brill analysis uses harmonic Einstein–Maxwell solutions and a vacuum-subtracted boundary action.

sources.title: Flows of extremal attractor black holes

evidence.text: Compute Hamiltonian surface energy, including cancellation of gravitational and scalar divergences: E = L²[M/2 + αβ + W(α)], with W = ∫₀^α β_b.c.(u)du. Boundary analysis uses an effective potential W + W₀, where W₀ = −∫₀^α β_s(u)du.

sources.title: Flows of extremal attractor black holes

evidence.text: Construct undeformed attractor solutions perturbatively around extremal planar Reissner–Nordström AdS. Equal charges Q_A = Q_B are imposed only in that perturbative subsection; the leading scalar perturbation sources metric backreaction at second order.

sources.title: Black holes and the swampland: the deep throat revelations

evidence.text: Does an infinitely deep, black-hole-like throat require infinite distance in the space of microstate solutions? The paper compares a mass-inferred distance with a canonical phase-space distance.

sources.title: An Alliance in the Tripartite Conflict over Moduli Space

evidence.text: What distance is assigned to a classical fixed-charge limit in which multicenter positions approach each other, the cap retains its intrinsic geometry, and an AdS2 throat becomes infinitely long?

sources.title: Extremalization approach to black hole thermodynamics: perturbations around higher-derivative gravities

evidence.text: Can Euclidean-action extremalization compute first-order black-hole thermodynamic corrections around known higher-derivative gravity backgrounds, retaining exact dependence on their original couplings and correctly treating AdS boundary data?

sources.title: Conformal Symmetry Breaking and Thermodynamics of Near-Extremal Black Holes

evidence.text: Does the scale at which gravitational backreaction breaks the apparent AdS2 conformal symmetry coincide with the thermodynamic mass gap of near-extremal black holes, and under what conditions does JT gravity explain this agreement?

sources.title: Classical black hole probes of UV scales

evidence.text: Can minimal extremal black holes constructed from two-derivative EFT data track species or Kaluza–Klein scales at infinite-distance limits, and can a species-length bound diagnose inconsistent EFTs?

sources.title: Extremal instability for topological black holes

evidence.text: Can the conjectured instability of cold, near-extremal planar AdS black holes impose a lower bound on the enthalpy density of holographically modelled cold strongly coupled matter?

sources.title: Geometric Flow Equations for Schwarzschild‐AdS Space‐Time and Hawking‐Page Phase Transition

evidence.text: Compare geometric evolution and thermal phase preference for a four-dimensional asymptotically AdS black hole. The independent metric scales are its geometrized mass M and AdS radius α, while the horizon is fixed by the positive root of the blackening function.

sources.title: On the Limits of Effective Quantum Field Theory: Eternal Inflation, Landscapes, and Other Mythical Beasts

evidence.text: Which thermal scales of a large AdS black hole enter the boundary-to-bulk interpretation of local perturbation decay?

sources.title: The statistical mechanics of near-extremal black holes

evidence.text: Does the semiclassical thermodynamic breakdown scale represent a genuine mass gap above extremality for non-supersymmetric Reissner–Nordström black holes, and what replaces semiclassical thermodynamics near that scale?

sources.title: The emergence of universal relations in the AdS black holes thermodynamics

evidence.text: Does a small constant deformation of the cosmological term reproduce entropy–extremality relations across selected AdS black holes, extend them to other thermodynamic conjugates, and support a WGC-like interpretation of corrected mass-to-charge behavior?

sources.title: Tale of three scales: The Planck, the species, and the black hole scales

evidence.text: Can neutral-black-hole thermodynamics reveal a scale below the species cutoff, where the gravitational EFT misses a more stable saddle even though its higher-curvature corrections remain small?

sources.title: Infinite Black Hole Entropies at Infinite Distances and Tower of States

evidence.text: Can the soft transitions between black-hole microstates be understood as horizon-symmetry modes? The source adopts a BMS-like supertranslation interpretation from earlier work and connects it to soft hair.
